name: srepollock-dotfiles
description: Claude Code mods from srepollock/dotfiles: delegation nudges, an agents/progress panel, and a context-window bar.

plugins.name: delegate-guard
plugins.description: Nudges the main agent to delegate to subagents when it pulls too much material into its own context, and records nudge stats per session.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel. Shows any subagents.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category; toggle with /context-bar.
